Mr Vegas Casino From Bojoko's Perspective

Mr Vegas from Bojoko's perspective is a very high-quality casino with lots of great features. What stood out to us was the slot game selection, which is one of the biggest in the UK. Mr Vegas is a sister site to another independent casino, Videoslots, which has become a very popular place to gamble.

Mr Vegas has a unique and stylish design that pleased our eyes and gave a nice experience. The casino didn't really lack anything. The overall usability was great, bonuses were good, and the game selection is top-class. We can't really say much negative about this casino. 

It was also very easy to find all the licensing information, which says clearly that they are licensed by the UKGC. This gives peace of mind knowing that the casino is safe.

Mr Vegas Welcome Bonus

All new players can redeem a nice match deposit bonus for their first deposit, including bonus spins without wagering requirements!

  • 100% bonus up to £50 + 11 wager-free bonus spins

This deposit bonus is not given to you as bonus money, but rather, you wager it first. It is paid in 10% increments as you keep playing. You have 60 days to complete it by wagering your deposit 10 times. This type of bonus is great, especially for slots fans.

The bonus spins are for the Pink Elephants 2 video slot and are automatically added to your account after you make your first deposit. These spins have no wagering requirement, and everything you win from them is withdrawable.

The wagering requirements on the Mr Vegas bonus are within the industry average. What was unique and what I liked was receiving cash as I went along and played, which was a nice little boost to the bonus.

Mr Vegas Casino Game Providers

Mr Vegas delivers a stunning lineup of game providers, filled with industry leaders like Relax Gaming, NetEnt, and Quickspin, and smaller studios that feature new innovative slots.

+107

Mr Vegas aims to give their customers as much choice as possible. This means that they have a massive selection of slots of all kinds. The games catalogue runs in the thousands, and they are constantly adding new slots and table games for you to enjoy. You can discover the new UK slots online page to see which games to keep an eye on.

Try their video slots, table games, video pokers, scratch cards, and jackpots. The last category is especially big on Mr Vegas. They have hundreds of jackpot games ranging from small to large, including Mega Moolah and Arabian Nights.

Mr Vegas also offers dozens of live dealer and classic table games, but the one that caught my eye was Lightning Roulette from Evolution Gaming. I played it and really enjoyed the format and dealers, who do a fantastic job of making the action immersive and bringing the experience of a brick-and-mortar casino to the desktops and mobiles of players.

Usability and User Experience

The first thing I noticed about Mr Vegas was the elegant black and green theme and the simple menus that allow quick access to all the games and other relevant parts of the site. It never takes more than a few clicks to get to where you want, and a simple search function will help you find the game you were looking for without any lost time.

You are bound to find your favourite games there. To make your searching easier, they have multiple game categories available, as well as games by developers, and search by name.

As the world of online gambling moves towards mobile, so is Mr Vegas. The casino works perfectly on both mobile and desktop.

You can access almost every game on your phone or tablet, no matter what device you have. Mr Vegas mobile casino is built with HTML5 technology, which makes it responsive, adaptive, and agile.

Mr Vegas mobile casino goes with you right in your pocket. Play on the couch, on the go or just because you prefer the mobile experience. Everything can be done with mobile, from account creation to deposits and withdrawals, and of course, playing the games.

After loading up Mr Vegas on my Samsung phone and scrolling through the wide selection of slots and table games, I found navigation throughout the site to be quick and easy. Most of the games I saw on the desktop site are also available on the Mr Vegas mobile client, which means you have access to thousands of games at your fingertips.

Mr Vegas offers various deposit methods, from debit cards (like Visa, Mastercard and Maestro payments) to e-wallet payments (like Neteller and Skrill), bank transfers, and a prepaid Paysafecard. I like the fact that they nowadays include Trustly, which allows instant withdrawal times. You can discover all casinos with Trustly to compare the best.

The minimum withdrawal the online casino processes is £20, with the maximum limit again being £10,000, a relatively high amount compared to Mr Vegas's competition. Players only have one fee-free withdrawal available per day, and if you wish to withdraw more frequently, those transactions will come with a £2.50 fee.

Mr Vegas's knowledgeable customer support team is there to help you. You can contact them via live chat, email or leave your number and they will call you. No matter what questions you may have, you'll get fast answers from the customer support agents.

Mr Vegas's customer support options are good, and the quality of service from the team was also impressive. Most of my questions were already answered by the operator's extensive FAQ section and the terms and conditions pages regarding the bonus. However, I still needed a bit of help when I wanted to cash out. So I turned to live chat, which seemed like the easiest option.

Although I had to wait a bit for the agent to pick up, my issues were resolved quickly by professional and polite agents. But if you prefer, you can also contact customer support via phone or email. Email replies took a few hours, even in reply to straightforward queries. So I would recommend using live chat whenever possible.

In accordance with gambling laws and licensor requirements, Mr Vegas must identify all of their customers. This means that you are required to provide them with accurate information on who you are.

This is first done at registration, where you need to fill in your information. Later, they may ask for documents to prove these.

The required documents include:

  • Proof of identity
  • Proof of address
  • Proof of deposit

Mr Vegas asks for four separate documents to verify your account and withdraw funds. These include proof of identity, proof of address, a picture of a debit card, and proof of payment method. I had to send both a photo of my debit card and a bank statement, which I thought was excessive.

The area used for uploading documents and verifying your account is detailed and intuitive. After submitting all relevant documents to Mr Vegas, they were processed within a few hours so that I could withdraw my winnings relatively quickly.

Mr Vegas takes responsible gambling very seriously. They want to provide a safe environment for the players, which also means that they offer you tools to regulate and restrict your own gambling.

If you ever feel like the games are taking over, and you are playing more than you should, don't hesitate to contact the support for help or set limits for yourself.

Available tools include:

  • Wager limits
  • Deposit limits
  • Time-out limits
  • Reality checks
  • Self-exclusion

You also get quick access from Mr Vegas to multiple gambling support groups. Professional third-party groups like GamCare, GambleAware and Gordonhouse are there to help you with any problems, no matter how big or small.

You can block access to Mr Vegas with Gamblock and Gamstop.
